home.onlineOnly: Saved online, not on this device
settings.saveOnline: Save my projects online and sync my devices
settings.onlineOn: Each piece is saved here first, then online a few seconds later, and comes to your other devices by itself. Free for up to {0} pieces.
settings.onlineOff: Saving online is off. Your projects stay on this device only and do not sync.
profile.name: Name
profile.nameHint: Shown in Motiff Lab instead of the name you signed in with.
profile.notSaved: The profile wasn't saved. Check the connection and try again.
profile.photoUnreadable: This file isn't a picture that can be read.
settings.accountWhy: Keep your projects online as well as here, so they open on your other devices, and let Motiff Lab's server read sheet music and recordings for you.
settings.signInHow: No password: each time, a code comes to your email.
online.signInFirst: Sign in on Settings to save projects online. They are kept on this device meanwhile.
settings.planUnknown: Not known yet: Motiff Lab's server did not answer.
settings.testPlanHint: Only testers see this switch. It changes what this device asks the servers for, to try both modes.
environment.title: Environment
environment.hint: Main is your real library, kept in the players' database. Test is the develop servers and their test database. Each has its own library on this iPad, and pieces never pass from one to the other.
environment.markLabel: Test environment: the library of the test database
environment.switchToTest: The library changes to the pieces of the test database. Your pieces in Main stay as they are, and nothing passes between the two.
environment.switchToMain: The library changes to your real pieces, in the players' database.
environment.switchToMainReadOnly: The library changes to your real pieces, in the players' database. In this test version it is read only: nothing changes online.
environment.readOnlyHint: This test version opens your real pieces but sends nothing to the players' database: what you change stays on this iPad.
environment.allowWritesMessage: This test version will send your changes to your real library online, and the web app will get them. A version not released yet may save a piece in a way the released app cannot read yet. Writing stays on until the next build is installed.
environment.notSaved: The Main environment is read only in this test version: nothing was saved online.
testLibrary.onlineFailed: Your copies in the test database could not be deleted (no connection, or the server did not answer). Nothing was deleted; try again in a minute.
testLibrary.notDevelop: The test environment here does not use the develop servers, so its online copies are not deleted from here. Nothing was deleted.
online.offline: Not saved online: no connection. The project is kept on this device and goes online with its next save.
online.problem: Saving online did not work this time. The project is kept on this device.
account.signInFailed: Signing in did not work. Your projects on this device are not affected.
testLibrary.busy: An import or a recognition is running: stop it first. Nothing was deleted.
testLibrary.cleared.many: {0} pieces deleted: the test library on this iPad is empty.
testLibrary.cleared.one: {0} piece deleted: the test library on this iPad is empty.
testLibrary.clearedFailed.many: {0} files could not be deleted; try again.
testLibrary.clearedFailed.one: {0} file could not be deleted; try again.
testLibrary.confirmMessage: Your copies in the test database and the test library on this iPad are deleted: its project files, marks and sync records, the folders added for import and the copies kept for playlists. The test library on your other devices (the web test site, another iPad) is cleared the next time they open the library or sync with this account. Signed out, only this iPad is cleared. Your original files (PDFs, recordings, folders added by link) are never touched, and the Main library stays as it is. This cannot be undone.
testLibrary.hint: Only in the test environment, for a new testing cycle: empties your data in the test database and the test library on every device you sign in with.
testLibrary.notTest: The iPad is not working in the test environment: nothing was deleted.
